objective: Verify the admin correction produces a coherent WordPress/product hybrid and a practical preset-to-Elementor handoff.
preconditions: Elementor Implementation Toolkit is active in the local WordPress runtime.
Elementor is active for template bridge verification.
TASK-014 through TASK-016 behavior remains present.
steps: Capture current admin screenshots before changes.
Generate and store a visual concept image for the hybrid admin direction.
Save a new Filter Preset through the save-and-open Elementor template path.
Verify the created Elementor template is plugin-owned and tagged with the preset id.
Run browser smoke against Filter Presets and Post Types repeaters.
Capture after screenshots for Dashboard, Presets list, Preset form, Post Types list, Post Type form, and Diagnostics.
expected_result: The admin presents a clear workflow in WordPress: setup, Theme Builder handoff, filters, then advanced options, while preserving the existing CPT builder and advanced preset contract.
pass_criteria: Theme Builder/Elementor handoff is visible near the top of the preset form.
Advanced preset options are collapsed by default and can be opened.
Save-and-open creates an Elementor template with _eit_template_role=filter_controller and _eit_filter_preset metadata.
Add filter and Add field browser actions still work.
No obvious desktop/mobile overflow appears in the captured pages.
